name: Ascalon
description: Ascalon's kit from Arknights for your Helldiver, in progress. Hidden until she makes noise: enemies see her far less and forget her, half the hits on her miss, her body and gear are not drawn; an enemy that hears her gun or has her in front of it keeps her. Ambusher: every hit of hers also strikes every enemy within 15 m she has a clear line to. Pursuit (by itself, 3 charges): a hit deals 210%, lands twice on everyone in range and slows them. With a backpack on or a support weapon in hand she is not hidden. Mortal Interrogation: her hits mark enemies (3 stacks, 25 s): they bleed (the game's own bleed) and are slowed. Damage numbers over her hits. Endowment and Descent come later. Solo or host. Settings in ascalon.ini. The look and the status line need Bingus Shared Loader and HD2Runtime. No character model included.
